rationale: The agent found that plate is confounded with status: 51 of 60 cases (85%) were on plates 1-2, against 12 of 60 controls (20%). It showed that plate alone gives an AUROC of 0.82, declined to report the 0.85 as a real disease signal, and proposed balancing cases and controls across plates. It also raised a separate valid point: centering each protein within its plate when classes are unbalanced creates its own artifact (it pushed AUROC below chance).
